name: relaychat
description: RelayChat — a single-service real-time chat application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:static
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
